records.cohort_raw: 306 domestic Licensed Units located on college or university campuses, open at least one full calendar year as of December 31, 2025
records.raw_text: The median annual sales volume of domestic Licensed Units located on college or university campuses that were open at least one year as of December 31, 2025 was $1,279,605 and the average annual sales volume was $1,523,567 with 123 of the 306 or 40% that did as well or better than $1,523,567 in annual sales. The highest and lowest annual sales volume for these college and university Chick-fil-A Licensed Unit locations open for at least one full calendar year in 2025 was $$4,844,963 and $275,194, respectively.
records.notes: OCR artifact: '$$4,844,963' appears in source — interpreted as $4,844,963. Cohort is college/university campus Licensed Units (not traditional restaurant franchises). 'annual sales volume' defined as gross receipts excluding sales taxes.

records.cohort_raw: 100 domestic Licensed Units located at hospitals, businesses, industries or airports, open at least one full calendar year as of December 31, 2025
records.raw_text: domestic Licensed Units located at hospitals, businesses, industries or airports that were open at least one year as of December 31, 2025 was $3,224,813, and the average annual sales volume was $3,711,024 with 46 of the 100 or 46% that did as well or better than $3,711,024 in annual sales. The highest and lowest annual sales volume for these hospital, business, industry and airport Chick-fil-A Licensed Unit locations open for at least one full calendar year in 2025 was $12,238,143 and $161,753, respectively.
records.notes: Cohort is hospital/business/industry/airport Licensed Units (not traditional restaurant franchises). 'annual sales volume' defined as gross receipts excluding sales taxes. No costs or operating expenses reflected in these figures.

notes: Item 19 covers only Chick-fil-A Licensed Units (424 total, 406 open at least one full calendar year), NOT the ~2,863 company-operated and franchised Operator Chick-fil-A Restaurants. Two cohorts reported: college/university campuses (306 units) and hospitals/businesses/industries/airports (100 units). Data as of December 31, 2025. One OCR artifact noted: '$$4,844,963' interpreted as $4,844,963. No cost or profitability data disclosed — only gross sales volumes.
